tests.evidence: tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php covers no-op for null and '' with Http::assertNothingSent (:15-22), exact POST URL + JSON content (:24-32), multibyte truncation to exactly 1800 (:34-40), key/bearer/nested redaction incl. case-insensitive keys (:42-67), non-2xx error log without token (:69-80) and transport exception scrubbed (:82-95). tests/Feature/LoggingConfigTest.php asserts daily/audit/stack/no discord. simplicity.evidence: Lean single class with small private helpers and Laravel's Http/Log facades. One piece of pointless indirection: DiscordOpsAlert.php:76 `array_map(fn ($v) => $v, $this->redactArray($value))` is an identity map. The stringify match (:101-110) is slightly more defensive than needed but reasonable.

readability.evidence: Clear names (format, redact, redactArray, stringify, scrubUrl), named constants (:17-25), class PHPDoc explaining the 'not a Monolog channel' intent. Nits: identity array_map at :76 reads like leftover code; `\Stringable` used fully-qualified inline (:107) while Throwable is imported; long json_encode flag line (:104); test file declares a global `const WEBHOOK` (DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:9) that could clash with another test file.

scope.evidence: All edits serve the task: notifier, services config, logging config, phpunit.xml env, .env.example keys, docs/ops/logging.md, plus CHANGELOG/README entries required by the docs-sync convention. No wiring into jobs/handlers, no embeds/retries (out of scope respected).

issues.explanation: The 'audit channel accepts writes' test asserts only expect(true)->toBeTrue() and writes a real file to storage/logs; it should assert something observable (e.g. Log::spy/channel fake or the file content) or be dropped in favor of the config assertions.
`array_map(fn ($v) => $v, $this->redactArray($value))` is an identity map; return `$this->redactArray($value)` directly.
A global `const WEBHOOK` in a Pest file lives in the global namespace and would collide with any other test file defining the same constant; a local variable or dataset is safer.
`\Stringable` is referenced fully-qualified inline while other classes (Throwable) are imported; import it for consistency.

review.summary: The change adds App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert (config-driven, no-op without webhook, key/bearer/nested redaction, 1800-char multibyte truncation, soft-fail logging with the webhook URL scrubbed), an audit daily channel, switches the stack default to daily, pins LOG_STACK in phpunit.xml, and documents the three lanes with CHANGELOG/README updates. All requirements and contract details are met with focused Pest tests for each behavior; only minor nits remain (an identity array_map, a vacuous audit-write test, a global test constant), so it is approvable with nits.
